name: @taalcut/desktop
description: Electron main, preload and utility-process wiring. The composition root.

scripts.package: pnpm build:mac-helper && pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-signature.mjs
scripts.package:dir: pnpm build:mac-helper && pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac --arm64 --dir --publish never && node scripts/verify-signature.mjs --built-app
scripts.package:linux: pnpm --filter @taalcut/renderer build && pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --linux deb --x64 --publish never && node scripts/linux/verify-deb.mjs
scripts.package:linux:dir: pnpm --filter @taalcut/renderer build && pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --linux dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.e2e:gate: pnpm --filter @taalcut/renderer build && TAALCUT_BUILD_FLAVOUR=test pnpm build && playwright test --project=gate --project=make --project=window --project=indexing
scripts.e2e:smoke: pnpm e2e:app && pnpm --filter @taalcut/renderer build && TAALCUT_BUILD_FLAVOUR=test pnpm build && playwright test --project=window
scripts.e2e:assets: pnpm e2e:app && pnpm --filter @taalcut/renderer build && TAALCUT_BUILD_FLAVOUR=test pnpm build && playwright test --project=gate --project=make --project=indexing
scripts.e2e:perf: pnpm --filter @taalcut/renderer build && TAALCUT_BUILD_FLAVOUR=test pnpm build && playwright test --project=perf
scripts.clean:build: node -e "for (const d of ['out', 'release', 'test-results']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.i18n:extract: lingui extract --clean && lingui compile --typescript && tsx packaging/write-info-plist-strings.ts
